mapper.update: UPDATE public.auth_password_reset_ticket SET status = 'SUPERSEDED', superseded_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{subjectId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE subject_type = 'TENANT_ACCOUNT' AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND is_deleted = false
mapper.select: SELECT id, subject_type, subject_id, reset_mode, ticket_hash, initiated_by_type, initiated_by_id, status, expires_at, consumed_time, version FROM public.auth_password_reset_ticket WHERE ticket_hash = #{ticketHash} AND is_deleted = false LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE public.auth_password_reset_ticket SET status = 'CONSUMED', consumed_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{ticketId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = false
